text:
maria.chen: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the internal announce for the v2.14.0 rollout. Target change window: Wed 10:00 PT. Need a 1-paragraph blurb + canary/rollback matrix.
samir: Thanks — can we lock the model pin to v2.14.0-rc3 for the hosted tier? avoids surprise drift.
devon_ops: +1 on pin. Also we should include the deploybot commands we'll run so ops can replay.
anna_pm: Draft blurb suggestion: 'Patch release: performance improvements for long-context decoding and a fix for tokenization mismatch. No breaking API changes. Rolling canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic regression check.' Thoughts? :eyes:
cheng: Sounds good. Add note about embedding latency improvement numbers (p50 ~20% lower) if we can be confident.
maria.chen: I'll add the perf stat from the bench doc. Devon — can you paste the deploybot sequence?
devon_ops: Sure — canonical sequence:
```
/deploy start v2.14.0 --canary 10 --wait 10m
/deploy promote --percent 50 --wait 15m
/deploy promote --percent 100
/deploy rollback v2.14.0-rc2 if regressions
```
Also we run `check-eval regressions --suite release-smoke` after each step.
samir: For rollback decision thresholds: set alert if latency p95 increases >15% OR correctness drift >2% on the smoke suite. If either triggers, rollback to v2.14.0-rc2 and pause.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by devon_ops. Job ID: db-7821. Canary will start when the queue reaches the front.
lexi: Quick Q — do we need a staging dry-run in eu-west? last time we had region-specific kv issues.
maria.chen: Good call. Let's run a staging dry-run in eu-west 24h before launch. Add to the announcement: 'staging dry-run scheduled Tue 10:00 PT (eu-west) — oncall will monitor.'
anna_pm: Who's oncall for Tue? @devon_ops?
devon_ops: I can take Tue dry-run. I'll tag eng-oncall and eng-sre for the Wed window too.
cheng: For the internal blurb, add the rollback owner contact: devon_ops (pager), samir (app lead). Also escalate path: page eng-sre if rollback fails.
maria.chen: Drafting final announce now. Will post in #eng-releases + #all-hands 2h before the window, and pin a deploy timeline. Leaving placeholders for perf numbers.
samir: Tiny edit: replace 'automatic regression check' with 'smoke-suite gating'. clearer.
maria.chen: done. Final checklist for me: add bench numbers, paste deploybot commands, add contact list, add staging dry-run note, and attach the rollback runbook link. I'll post the draft in 30m for review. :thumbsup:
devon_ops: I'll attach the canary monitoring dashboard link and set up alerting rules ahead of the window.
deploy-bot: Canary started for db-7821 at 1786550400. 10% traffic routed to v2.14.0.
lexi: Thanks — watching dashboards. If we see p95 creep I'll post a quick note.
maria.chen: great team — thanks. If anyone has wording nits ping me.
